items.name: Brass Memory Spring
items.effect: A crafted tool may repeat its last simple mechanical motion once.

items.name: Silver Resonance Wire
items.effect: Carries one chosen vibration between two connected points.

items.name: Matched Ward Nails
items.effect: Anchors a temporary boundary or stabilizes a damaged circle.

items.name: Miniature Counterweight Core
items.effect: Lets a crafted object balance against an apparently impossible load.

items.name: Stormground Ring
items.effect: A fitted item can safely ground one minor magical arc before needing repair.

items.name: Moonglass Prism
items.effect: Separates layered magical traces into distinct visible colors.

items.name: Tide Lock
items.effect: Opens only at a chosen water level.

items.name: Echo-Flagstone Chip
items.effect: Stores a weak physical impulse and releases it when tapped.

items.name: Map That Avoids You
items.effect: Draws nearby routes except the one currently occupied by its holder.

items.name: Future-Echo Shell
items.effect: Once per day, produces one ambiguous sound likely to occur nearby within the next minute.

items.name: Self-Folding Letter
items.effect: Folds itself into a creature indicating the writer's mood.

items.name: Gravity-Shy Coin
items.effect: Falls sideways while watched and normally while ignored.
